I kept a running donation box for 6 months in my apartment, and would periodically throw clothes in there when I felt ready to donate them. There were a lot of clothes in there near the end and they ranged from more inexpensive stuff like F21 and H&M to slightly more expensive clothes from Ann Taylor and J.Crew. Nothing extremely expensive/designer, but there were clothes in there that were barely worn or still with tags on them.
